# zego_uikit_prebuilt_live_streaming

**Tag**: live, livestream, livestreaming, live-streaming, pk, ui

## 简介

PrebuiltLiveStreaming is a full-featured live streaming kit that provides realtime video/audio streaming, live text chat, face beautification, and supports unlimited viewers.

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.zegocloud.com/
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/ZEGOCLOUD/zego_uikit_prebuilt_live_streaming_flutter
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/zego_uikit_prebuilt_live_streaming
